name: SysMon
author: gdeyoung
description: Compact RAM/CPU/net/disk meters that expand into a full performance popup: charts, histograms, rainbow per-core grid, GPU load, disk I/O

barWidget.description: RAM (/proc/meminfo), CPU (/proc/stat deltas), net rate (interface counters), whole-disk usage (df + lsblk) — click for the detail popup with time-series, histograms, per-core grid and GPU stats
